messages:
Lynne: FYI I opened a docs PR for a Windows offline installer + KMS/HSM notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827 - focuses on SMB mirror for artifacts, PKCS#11 caveats, and service account perms. TL;DR: small PowerShell snippets and checklist.

Omar: looking now. Quick q — are we recommending SMB only or also an HTTPS artifact mirror for airgapped sites? SMB can be flaky over SMBv1/2 differences.

Lynne: Good point. Intention was to show both options, but the PR only had the SMB example. I'll add an HTTPS mirror example and note performance tradeoffs. :+1:

Sanjay: Security note: call out signed driver requirement for HSM on Windows (driver signing policy), and add guidance on enabling Windows driver signing enforcement exceptions for vendor-signed modules. Also include steps to restrict service account that accesses the SMB share.

Rachel: CI caught an installer smoke failure when running the windows-smoke job against the PR branch. Short log:```
2026-02-12T15:02:10Z ERROR installer: failed to mount \\10.0.2.15\artifacts
System.IO.IOException: The network path was not found.
```
It repros when the test VM uses SMBv3 with multichannel off.

Lynne: Thanks — I pushed a commit that switches the example to use Invoke-WebRequest for the HTTPS case and adds an SMB troubleshooting appendix (SMBv2/v3 notes). I also added a note to ensure Netlogon/NetBIOS config for older AD-integrated setups.

Omar: can you add a snippet to show checksum verification after download? A one-liner PowerShell is good.

Lynne: Added this to PR:```powershell
$hash = Get-FileHash .\\redwood-installer.zip -Algorithm SHA256; if ($hash.Hash -ne 'REPLACE_WITH_SHA256') { throw 'checksum mismatch' }
```

Sanjay: Also add PKCS11 provider path examples for common Windows HSM vendors (YubiHSM2, Thales Luna, SafeNet). Even a short table with vendor -> DLL path is fine.

Lynne: Will add vendor table. Question for docs-bot: linter flagged a relative link in the HSM appendix earlier — can you run the link checker on the branch?

docs-bot: link-checker/4827 started. Found 1 broken anchor in docs/hsm/windows.md#pkcs11-examples -> suggest fix to anchor name.

Lynne: Fixed the anchor and pushed. Anyone ok to approve after a quick pass? I want this merged before tomorrow's release cut. :eyes:

Rachel: I'll re-run the windows-smoke job after the HTTPS + checksum changes. If green, approve.

Omar: LGTM for infra examples, minor nit about phrase "open firewall ports" -> prefer "allow egress to mirror host on port 443/445 as appropriate".

Sanjay: LGTM once HSM vendor DLL paths are added and we call out driver signing. Approve pending those edits.

Lynne: Great — I'll follow up with a short migration checklist for customers moving from our linux-only quickstart to the new windows offline flow (steps: backup config, export KMS keys, vendor driver install window, verify PKCS11 mapping). I'll tag you all in the checklist PR. Thanks!
